# Generated pre-unification saves

Eight synthetic fixtures, created and successfully loaded by the frozen pre-unification client. No player data is included. Exact original byte hashes are in manifest.json. These cover an untouched preset, public closed layout, purchased land/custom finishes/paid wall and window, deliberately bare grass, fully removed structure, payroll/progress, and paid inherited shell allocations plus a purchased ninth-edge overlay.

The unified-building regression reads these immutable originals, checks exact recovery backups, and compares every non-building field after migration. Do not refresh them from the new writer: they are old-client compatibility evidence. The reproducible old source, generator, and recovery instructions are preserved in the matching Little Leaf unified building recovery packet.
